concept: Matchday 5 is one night with three moods, so the design is a mood board in green. The hero stacks two confident lines in grey (Real perfect, Arsenal unbeaten) and the one anxious line in white (City need a response), because the pressure is the story. Slide 2 puts all five clubs in tonight's three big games on one bar chart of points, so you see at a glance that the favourites sit near the top and their visitors near the cut. Then one slide per game: Real's 9 straight wins as a giant number, Arsenal's absences as a list and De Bruyne's return to City as the human hook, ending on a question for fans. Type and shapes only: no player photos, no club or UEFA logos.
caption:
Real Madrid are perfect. Arsenal are unbeaten. Man City need a response.

Champions League Matchday 5 is tonight, with three big games at 1:30 am IST. Real Madrid have won all four league-phase games and nine in a row overall. They host PSV for the first time in Europe since 1989.

Arsenal are third and unbeaten but face Dortmund without David Raya, Bukayo Saka and Martin Zubimendi. Kepa starts in goal.

City are seventh with 9 points and have not won any of their last four league games. Their visitors are Napoli, 27th, with Kevin De Bruyne back at the Etihad.

Which of the three is in most danger tonight? Tell us below.

Via beIN, Goal, Sports Mole, SI and Football365.
